newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka says navy attacked by Tamil Tigers.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka says navy attacked by Tamil Tigers.

text.p: The Sri Lankan navy repulsed an attack at sea by Tamil Tiger guerrillas off the northeastern coast early on Monday, killing several rebels and sinking at least 10 of their boats, a navy spokesman said.

"Some 25-30 rebels boats took us about 10 miles off Mullaitivu after midnight on Sunday. They were met by an equal and strong force from our side and their flotilla was destroyed," the spokesman told Reuters.
The spokesman said one naval man died and five were wounded in the attack which began at about 1.45 a.m. (1945 GMT) and continued for four hours.
"We have sustained minor damages to our boats," the spokesman said. He did not say how many naval boats were involved in the attack.
He said an estimated 100 Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) rebels were killed when the navy returned fire. "Their remaining boats were seen limping back to Mullaitivu."
The LTTE rebels are fighting a 13 year old war for a separate homeland in the island's north and east.
